problem_statement: The vendor OUI is handled only as a fixed 24-bit value, so it cannot represent the longer Organizationally Unique Identifier prefix lengths (28-bit and 36-bit) defined by the spec. A device configured with, or required to report, a non-24-bit OUI cannot store, validate, or render it: a 28- or 36-bit OUI cannot be set, parsed from a configuration value, compared, or converted to its canonical hyphenated hex string form. The behavior required is support for variable-length vendor OUIs (24, 28, and 36 bits): setting an OUI from raw bytes or another OUI value, validating its length, computing its size, deriving the 24-bit equivalent, comparing for equality, and rendering the human-readable string (e.g. '00-1A-2B', '00-1A-2B-3', '00-1A-2B-3C-4'), plus a compile-time validation of the configured OUI value.
